notes.note: Reviewed the bounded outbound retry delta against useOutboundQueueFlush, outboundDispatch and mounted separate-renderer regressions. The module map retains accurate effect fencing, exact-key settlement and send-only projection claims; detailed retry lifecycle belongs to the updated offline queue design. Tests exercise hidden/browser-offline/unreachable pauses, immediate resume with 2-second reset, one lookup per backoff step, unmount/hidden takeover within 3 seconds and 15-second crash expiry. UI/e2e typechecks and 130 owner/sibling tests passed. No provider, packaged native or hosted qualification is inferred.
